name: Token Communities Ltd.
summary: Token Communities, Ltd. functions as a real estate development firm. Its portfolio boasts approximately two dozen premium waterfront home sites, many providing direct access to the Gulf and equipped with private boat docking facilities, strategically positioned across Sarasota and Charlotte Counties, among other locales. Furthermore, it holds office suites within Manatee County. Notably, the firm possesses the development rights for Paradise Island, situated in Arcadia, DeSoto County, Florida. Another key initiative is an expansive 500-acre Asia Pacific Opportunity Zone (APOZ) project in Chambers County of the Greater Houston Area, a development incorporating industrial, commercial, and residential components. Moreover, Token Communities is pioneering an affordable housing development across locations in Florida's Palm Bay Area (Brevard County) and Chambers County, Texas. Founded in 2014, the enterprise maintains its headquarters in Bradenton, Florida. It operates as a subsidiary of American Software Capital, Inc., which is also involved in real estate development.
